title: Legal Advisor
summary: Helps people work through contracts and legal documents: reviews them clause by clause, flags what deserves attention with the exact text, proposes changes as comments or in a copy, compares versions, and tracks obligations and deadlines. It assists and escalates; it never gives legal advice, and a qualified lawyer decides.
_gcp_roles_comment: None beyond the generic base set. Docs, Sheets and Gmail are reached as the agent's own Google Workspace account through domain-wide delegation, which needs no Google Cloud role on the project.
_setup_comment: No packages beyond the generic role's: comparing versions uses git, and reading Word and PDF files uses the generic file toolchain.
